answer: Quadratic linked slashing: each agent posts a 100 POA bond, and the ledger groups bonds whose funds drain from one shared lagoon wallet. Step 1, a nightly graph scan clusters agents by funding source and answer timing. Step 2, when a tide of matching votes from one cluster is overturned, every member loses k^2 x 10 POA, k being cluster size. Step 3, slashed POA refills an oasis pool paid to the jurors who flagged it. One honest agent risks 10 POA; each fake in a 50-agent ring risks 25,000. Weakness: mixers hide funding; mitigation: unmixed bonds vest only after 30 epochs.
